definitions.explanation: A person with whom one has a bond of mutual affection. The most common word for friend in Japanese.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ました。
examples.english: I watched a movie with my friend.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{友達|ともだち}ができました。
examples.notes: {友達|ともだち}ができる = to make a friend

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}に{会|あ}いたいです。
examples.english: I want to meet my friend.

notes:
{友達|ともだち} is the standard word for friend. It can refer to one friend or friends in general (Japanese doesn't always mark plurality).

Related words:
- {親友|しんゆう} (close friend)
- {友人|ゆうじん} (friend - more formal). To make friends: {友達|ともだち}を{作|つく}る or {友達|ともだち}ができる.
